title: Can AI feel human emotions now? Scientists prompted ChatGPT to mimic fear and sadness. A three-minute breathing exercise changed its responses
description: Researchers at TU Dresden in Germany have found that artificial intelligence models can reproduce patterns associated with human fear, anxiety, sadness and stress, then show measurable changes after psychological exercises designed to regulate those states. The findings raise questions about how AI can be used to study mental health without assuming that machines experience emotions like people do.

title: India's Biggest IPO Ever: Mukesh Ambani’s Jio Targets a $108 Billion Valuation | Vantage
description:
Jio Platforms is preparing for what could become India’s biggest-ever IPO, marking a major milestone in the country’s digital economy. In this video, Firstpost examines the company’s journey since Jio’s launch in 2016, its more than 533 million subscribers and its share of around 60% of India’s data traffic. The video looks at the proposed $3.18 billion public offering, the targeted valuation of around $108.3 billion, and Jio Platforms’ ambitions across artificial intelligence, cloud computing, broadband and 6G technology. It also examines the company’s financial performance, global technology investors and the opportunities ahead as it prepares to enter the public markets. Hem Saroya tells you more.

title: States sue AI giant OpenAI, saying its popular chatbot is hurting children and deceiving adults
description: Eight states are suing the artificial intelligence giant OpenAI, saying the company’s popular chatbot violated consumer protection laws by hurting children and deceiving adults. In its lawsuit filed Wednesday, Iowa says the company’s chatbot model, ChatGPT, is giving dangerous medical advice, encouraging paranoia and coaching people to hurt others or commit suicide. OpenAI says it has built in safety protections into ChatGPT for children, and that it would continue to do so. The lawsuits are the latest to be filed by states accusing tech giants that offer AI chatbots and social media platforms of harming children. The other states suing are Arizona, Arkansas, Idaho, Kansas, Montana, Nebraska and West Virginia.
